create_Plan: create a Plan instance with a list of Migration objects to manage database migrations
run_Plan_execute: run the Plan execute method to apply pending migrations with automatic rollback on failure
test_Plan_get_planned_migrations: test the Plan get_planned_migrations method to determine which migrations need to be applied
review_Plan_rollback: review the Plan rollback method that reverses applied migrations on failure
summarize_Plan_apply: summarize the Plan apply method that applies migrations in order with save, up, and validate steps
